release_read.basis: The 45-BlueBird target slipped from 'early 2027' to 'mid-2027', BB14-16 still await a SpaceX date and the rest launch in Q1 2027, EPS -0.44 vs Nasdaq -0.41 and Blacklift has no capex number; revenue guide $150-200m only 'maintained' with Q3 at $42.3m, offset partly by $1.0bn Japan non-dilutive funding and $3.2bn cash, after a +15% run into the print.

release.headline: AST SpaceMobile Provides Business Update and Third Quarter 2026 Results

vs_bar.note: no consensus revenue found in the time available; up from $14.7m a year ago

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast carried in the brief (fallback, 7 estimates)

key_line.detail: About 45 BlueBirds in orbit now targeted by mid-2027 (the hunt's documents had 'early 2027'); BB14-16 at the Cape awaiting SpaceX launch-date confirmation, BB17-19 on Blue Origin in early Q1 2027, BB20-25 in Q1 2027; >100 satellites contracted cumulatively 2027-2028; Blacklift from late 2028, no capex disclosed.

guidance.detail: 'Remain on target' for $150-200m revenue guidance, with possible upside from new contracts; Q3 $42.3m means Q4 has to be well above the record quarter. Intermittent nationwide US service by year-end 2026; six satellites a month production in December.

call.detail: Call held last night at 17:00 ET; no transcript read in the time available. After-hours sat only -0.74% vs the close, so the selling built overnight and into the pre-market rather than on the release.

public_reaction.summary: Stocktwits headline (snippet_only): 'AST SpaceMobile Stock Tumbles As Losses Widen Sharply In Q3: But Retail Stays Defiant' - press tone negative on losses, retail defiant. No analyst actions searched for lack of time.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 34.68 = -5.99% vs prev close 36.89, against a frozen release read of -7.0% and an implied move of 11.26%; pre-market active (191 prints, 29 in the last 30 min, last at 09:17, not stale), range 34.40-37.50 so it opened the morning near flat and sagged. Market weak too (QQQ -1.0%, IWM -0.9%), so part of the move is beta. Short is up about 5.8% from entry.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was deployment behind the 45-by-early-2027 target, a stretched revenue guide and unquantified Blacklift capex: the release moves the 45 target to mid-2027, keeps the guide only as 'on target' and gives no Blacklift cost. The $1.0bn Japan funding and $3.2bn cash are the offsets.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market so the open should hold the -6% move; amc gap on a heavily shorted, retail-loved name (22-24% short interest, 'retail stays defiant') tends to give part back after the open, and the pre-market is already close to the release read, so little is left for the short.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers bevestigen de short-these (doel van 45 satellieten verschoven naar medio 2027, verlies groter dan verwacht), en de voorbeurs staat met circa -6% al ongeveer waar de cijfers het aandeel heen rechtvaardigen. Bij een zwaar geshort aandeel met veel enthousiaste particuliere beleggers is de kans op een opleving na de opening reeel, dus de winst bij de opening nemen volgens de standaardregel.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurs voor 09:30 verder wegzakt richting -9% of lager op stevige handel en negatieve analistenacties, dan pas is vasthouden tot 10:00 of de slotkoers te overwegen.
